[[File:Melvin.png|thumb|250px|Melvin]] '''Melvin''' (Japanese: '''マギー''' ''McGee'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP043|The March of the Exeggutor Squad]]''. He is a struggling magician who always had bad luck. His dream is to get to perform at {{wp|Broadway theatre|Broadway}} (changed to {{wp|Las Vegas}} in the English [[dub]]). When {{an|Misty}} ran into him at a carnival in [[Kanto]], his assistant had just quit on him. Feeling bad for him, Misty became his new assistant, but it didn't improve his magic show. When {{Ash}} was questioning Melvin about what good his {{p|Exeggcute}} was, they used {{m|Hypnosis}} on him, putting him under Melvin's control. He had Ash weaken a group of {{p|Exeggutor}}, which Melvin proceeded to capture. He planned to use them to hypnotize everybody at the carnival into attending his show. However, after his own Exeggcute [[Evolution|evolved]] into Exeggutor, it hypnotized the other Exeggutor into stampeding throughout the carnival, destroying everything in sight. Melvin didn't know what to do, but with the help of Misty and [[Ash's Charmander]], he was able to create his own fire to snap the Exeggutor out of their hypnosis and return everything back to normal. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Melvin's Pokémon in the {{pkmn|animated series}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Melvin |pkmn=Exeggutor |stage1=Exeggcute |type1=Grass |type2=Psychic |img=Melvin Exeggcute.png |cap=Melvin's Exeggcute |img2=Melvin Exeggutor.png |cap2=Melvin's Exeggutor |epnum=EP043 |epname=The March of the Exeggutor Squad |desc=Melvin originally used this {{p|Exeggutor}} as an {{p|Exeggcute}} in his magic show. After Exeggcute hypnotized Ash, Melvin decided to use him to catch himself multiple Exeggutor. When {{TRT}} arrived in order to steal the Coconut Pokémon, Exeggcute [[Evolution|evolved]] into another Exeggutor. When the Exeggutor hypnotized each other, they started rampaging away. When all of the Exeggutor were freed from the hypnosis, Melvin's original Exeggutor returned back to him, making him very happy. They were together saying goodbye when Ash and {{AP|friends}} left. Exeggutor's only known move is {{m|Hypnosis}}.}} ===Status unknown=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Melvin |pkmn=Exeggutor (multiple) |type1=Grass |type2=Psychic |img=Melvin multiple Exeggutor.png |cap=Melvin's Exeggutor |epnum=EP043 |epname=The March of the Exeggutor Squad |desc=Melvin caught these multiple Exeggutor with the help of hypnotized Ash and his {{AP|Squirtle}}, {{AP|Bulbasaur}} and {{AP|Charmander}}. When the Exeggutor started marching around under their own hypnosis, Melvin helped Ash's Charmander with his "Raging Fire" magic trick to wake them up. After this the Exeggutor walked away. However, it isn't especially mentioned that they were released, so it's possible that Melvin still owns them.
